propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh must be ported from shell to a stdlib-only Python entry point that implements the same pure function f(CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) -> vote in {success, failure, cancelled}

The existing subprocess contract test in test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py must be re-pointed at the Python entry point (proving CLI parity) while preserving its full case table and adding direct unit tests of the function

The workflow gerrit-verify.yaml must update its sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new .py file (with cone-mode: false) and update the run invocation to call the Python entry point
The Python entry point must be dependency-free (stdlib-only) so a single-file sparse-checkout works without package installation

The ported function must handle all contract cases including pass-through (success/failure/cancelled), skipped fallback (to success if FAILURE_OBSERVED=false, to failure if true), and fail-closed anomalies (empty or unrecognized CONCLUSION), with FAILURE_OBSERVED defaulting to false when unset
